newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Sept 11.

text.p: * United HealthCare Corp said it is negotiating a health insurance contract with the American Association of Retired Persons that represents about $4.5 billion in annual premiums. United HealthCare shares closed Tuesday at 38-5/8.
* United TransNet Inc and Corporate Express Inc said they agreed to merge. United TransNet will swap 0.45 share for each Corporate Express share.
Also, United TransNet said its third quarter earnings would fall short of analysts' expectations. United TransNet closed at 15-1/2, and Corporate Express closed at 32-3/4.
* Motorola Inc said its third quarter earnings may be significantly below those of the second quarter, as well as below analysts' estimates. Shares closed at 50-3/4.

* Elan Corp Plc said it would exercise its option to buy Advanced Therapeutic for $36 cash per share. Elan said it would incur a $141 million charge for the deal. Elan closed at 32-1/8, and Advanced Therapeutic at 34-1/4.
* Empire of Carolina said it expects to report a loss for 1996 due to high manufacturing costs. Shares closed at 5-3/8.
